panels.title: 1. 로그 도착 상태 (출처별 건수 · 마지막 수신 시각)

targets.rawSql: SELECT source AS "출처", COUNT(*) AS "누적 건수", MAX(received_at_utc) AS "마지막 수신(UTC)" FROM raw_logs GROUP BY source ORDER BY source;
SELECT status AS "상태", COUNT(*) AS "건수", MAX(updated_at_utc) AS "최근 갱신(UTC)" FROM action_approvals GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

SELECT incident_id AS "사건 ID", title AS "제목", status AS "상태", severity AS "심각도", target_ip AS "대상 IP", username AS "계정", created_at_utc AS "발생 시각(UTC)" FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC LIMIT 20;
